method.sole_definition: Alpha>=128 largest connected component inside a per-side ROI around each boot; sole = alpha-weighted centroid of the lowest 2 rows of that component.
method.anatomy: Character faces right. screen-left ROI -> left_foot; screen-right ROI -> right_foot. Confirmed by visual inspection of silver boots.
method.exclusions: Spear butt and blue cape excluded by ROI placement. Slam impact graphic excluded via narrowed right ROI on light3 frames 10-15 (frame 13 tightest).
method.states: grounded if sole y within 2px of the lower sole that frame; lifted if >=4px higher; else partial. support_foot = grounded/partial foot with lower sole (ties: nearer x=128).
method.null_policy: If a boot cannot be isolated, sole_xy/state/confidence are null — never invented.

light1.notes: Offsets hold a SAME planted foot fixed within a stretch. Stance changes / foot swaps are body motion and must NOT be cancelled by root. Do not align every frame lowest silhouette to y=248.

idle_reference.note: Idle package uses ground line near y=249/250 in README; Run uses nominal (128,248). Attack package nominal root is (128,248).

run_reference_frame0.note: Run frame0 is mid-stride; one or both feet may be lifted. Not a standing calibration pose.

engine_recommendation: Attack sprites are drawn at ~79.66% of Idle equivalent scale and ~82.67% of Run equivalent scale (from export transform union fit).

To place Attack under the same world root as Idle/Run, either (a) scale Attack draw size by 1/relative_scale (~1.255× toward Idle, ~1.210× toward Run) around nominal root (128,248), OR (b) keep Attack scale and accept smaller on-screen character with separate hitboxes.
Do NOT only translate root by Idle-minus-Attack sole deltas without scale compensation — those deltas mix pose difference and scale.
After scale match, align using planted support sole (prefer left sole on Idle-like poses) rather than lowest silhouette (spear butt / cape / impact FX can be lower).
Idle left sole ≈ [113.12, 249], right ≈ [176.736, 242]; Attack recover-end left ≈ [108.253, 242], right ≈ [156.765, 236].

engine_usage.preferred: For each frame, if registration.source_slide_flag, apply recommended_root_offset_xy_to_hold_planted_foot relative to the stretch start when you want a locked plant. Otherwise keep offset (0,0) and let stance/weight shift play as body animation.
engine_usage.absolute: planted_sole_minus_nominal_root_xy tells where the planted sole sits vs (128,248) if the engine parents sprites to that root.
engine_usage.do_not: Do not snap every frame lowest silhouette or both soles to (128,248). That erases lunges and lifts. Do not treat spear tip / impact FX / cape as feet.
